rows.details: Spectrum Institute of Management and Computer Sciences (SIMCS), Hyderabad

content_sections.heading: About SIMCS
content_sections.text: Spectrum Institute of Management and Computer Sciences (SIMCS) is an institute approved by AICTE and affiliated to Osmania University. It is located near Victoria Memorial Metro Station, Pillar No. 1623, Green Hills Colony, Road No. 1, Kothapet, Hyderabad - 500035. The advertised faculty posts are for its MBA and MCA Programs. The notice is signed by the Secretary of the institute and does not state whether the institute is a government or a private institution.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Programmes
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for three faculty posts in two programmes. It does not print the number of posts for any post or programme.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not list a qualification or experience for each post. It states that the eligibility for all three posts is as per AICTE Norms . For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification and the AICTE Norms it refers to.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The salary for the Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts is as per AICTE Norms . The notice prints no pay amount, pay level or allowance. The nature of the appointment (regular or contract) and its tenure are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SIMCS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice gives email as the way to apply. Applications are open as of 16 November 2026. Prepare your application for the post of Professor, Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in the MBA or MCA Program. Send the application to the email ID [email protected] . Make sure the application is sent on or before 25/11/2026 . For any query, contact +91-8121118644. The notice does not mention an application form, a list of documents or an email subject line. Address: Near Victoria Memorial Metro Station, Pillar No. 1623, Green Hills Colony, Road No. 1, Kothapet, Hyderabad - 500035 Email: [email protected] Phone: 8121118644 (also printed as +91-8121118644) Website: www.simcs.edu.in
